def mona_deleted_strategy_version(artifact: Artifact) -> str | None:
    """Preserve the execution version of a product-deleted strategy."""
    reason = artifact.disabled_reason or ""
    if artifact.type is not ArtifactType.STRATEGY or not reason.startswith(MONA_DELETED_STRATEGY_PREFIX):
        return None
    version = reason[len(MONA_DELETED_STRATEGY_PREFIX):]
    return version if len(version) == 64 and all(char in "0123456789abcdef" for char in version) else None
